_comment: Map 33, the meadow behind the castle (cut from the editor screenshot Resources/Remastered/Maps/Map_33 and grown by 8 tiles of grass on every side, grid_screenshot_map.py --pad 8, so the screenshot's (x, y) is (x + 8, y + 8) here: Sol starts at (14, 15) -- the screenshot's (6, 7) -- and Ares stands at (17, 13), its (9, 5)). Ares (003) dozes here; walking up to him plays 03, walking up to him again plays 04, and then the game goes on to Map 34. Positions are 1-based (X column, Y row) from the top-left. Trigger: Step = arriving on one of the tiles (Rows / Columns = whole lines), Near = arriving on a tile next to one of them, Face = coming to face one. Once fires the first time only; Requires lists the event Ids that must have played first; Then runs once the talk is over (Map: go to that free-field map; Spawn: put creatures here). Talk: conversations of Resources/Original/Strings/Maps/Chapter-00.strings under their own numbers, in ChapterStrings-33 (3-11); speaker ids are creature ids, which are also their portraits (1 Sol, 2 Yuni, 3 Ares, 4 Gaia).
